## 1. CONTEXT

The Evidence & Interaction column's `QaEvidenceCard` ends every un-reviewed Q&A answer with a review-choice prompt ("Good with this analysis, or would you prefer deeper theories?" + two buttons). Today it renders as a plain `T.cardAlt` box with an italic muted question and two flat outlined buttons — visually indistinguishable from the read-only prose above it. John's own screenshots showed users missing that this block requires action. This session gives that block a distinct "needs your input" visual treatment (gradient card, badge, bold question, prominent primary button) worked out interactively with John over several mock iterations — approved final version confirmed live in this session.

An identical copy of the same block exists, dormant, inside `MessageBubble` (chat renderer) — gated on a `needs_review` condition that no message today ever sets for a non-`qa` kind. It's unreachable in the live app but exists "just in case" a future message type needs it (comment at that call site, `S-MI-51`). Both copies get the same restyle so they don't visually drift apart if the dormant one is ever activated.

## 5. DESIGN RULES

- Tokens: `T.brassGlow`, `T.white` (new, Task 1), `T.brass`, `T.navy`, `T.card`, `T.mutedDeep`, `T.line` (existing).
- Fonts: `body` (Inter) for question text and buttons, `mono` (JetBrains Mono) for the badge — per `STYLE-GUIDE.md` Section 2.
- All corners squared (`borderRadius:0`) — no rounded corners anywhere in this block, including the badge chip.
- `<Corners/>` (brass bracket ornament, `STYLE-GUIDE.md` Section 3) renders on the review-choice block itself, requiring its own `position:"relative"` wrapper (separate from the outer card's, which needs `position:"relative"` only for `FeatureBadge`).
- This is a new pattern — not a variant of `ConfirmationCard` (Section 16) or the existing flat-fill card family (Section 3). `STYLE-GUIDE.md` gets a new Section 35 (committed by this design session alongside this kickoff, not a coding-session task) documenting it as its own locked "needs your input" pattern, and noting the navy CTA as a scoped exception to Section 7's brass-gradient Primary CTA rule — scoped to this one pattern, not a general Primary CTA change.

## 7. NODE.JS TEST

Save as `test-chi04.mjs` in the worktree root, run with `node test-chi04.mjs`, delete before committing.

```js
import fs from 'fs';

const tokensSrc = fs.readFileSync('src/tokens.js', 'utf8');
const screenSrc = fs.readFileSync('src/screens/MarketIntelligenceScreen.jsx', 'utf8');

let failures = [];

// Category M — new tokens defined once, correct values
const brassGlowMatches = tokensSrc.match(/brassGlow\s*[:=]\s*['"]#f0d99a['"]/g) || [];
const whiteMatches = tokensSrc.match(/white\s*[:=]\s*['"]#ffffff['"]/gi) || [];
if (brassGlowMatches.length !== 1) failures.push(`T.brassGlow defined ${brassGlowMatches.length} times in tokens.js, expected exactly 1`);
if (whiteMatches.length !== 1) failures.push(`T.white defined ${whiteMatches.length} times in tokens.js, expected exactly 1`);

// Category M — the two render sites must both use the tokens, never a hardcoded literal
const hardcodedGold = screenSrc.match(/#f0d99a/g) || [];
const hardcodedWhiteLiteral = screenSrc.match(/#ffffff/gi) || [];
if (hardcodedGold.length > 0) failures.push(`MarketIntelligenceScreen.jsx hardcodes #f0d99a directly (${hardcodedGold.length}x) instead of using T.brassGlow`);
if (hardcodedWhiteLiteral.length > 0) failures.push(`MarketIntelligenceScreen.jsx hardcodes #ffffff directly (${hardcodedWhiteLiteral.length}x) instead of using T.white`);

// Full locked CTA copy present verbatim, both render sites (STYLE-GUIDE.md Section 28)
const lockedCopy = 'Have Priya (Forecast/Theory/Performance Expert) generate a few theories →';
const copyCount = screenSrc.split(lockedCopy).length - 1;
if (copyCount !== 2) failures.push(`Expected the full locked CTA copy to appear exactly 2 times (QaEvidenceCard + MessageBubble), found ${copyCount}`);

// Badge text present at both sites
const badgeCount = (screenSrc.match(/Needs your input/g) || []).length;
if (badgeCount !== 2) failures.push(`Expected "Needs your input" badge text 2 times, found ${badgeCount}`);

// FeatureBadge for CHI-05 present exactly once (Section 6 — one badge per feature ID per file)
const featureBadgeCount = (screenSrc.match(/<FeatureBadge id="CHI-05"\/>/g) || []).length;
if (featureBadgeCount !== 1) failures.push(`Expected exactly 1 <FeatureBadge id="CHI-05"/>, found ${featureBadgeCount}`);

// No rounded corners introduced in either new block (spot-check: no borderRadius other than 0 near the new gradient)
const gradientBlocks = screenSrc.split('brassGlow').slice(1);
gradientBlocks.forEach((chunk, i) => {
  const nearby = chunk.slice(0, 900);
  const radiusMatches = nearby.match(/borderRadius:\s*[^0][\d]*/g) || [];
  if (radiusMatches.length > 0) failures.push(`Gradient block ${i + 1} has a non-zero borderRadius nearby: ${radiusMatches.join(', ')}`);
});

if (failures.length) {
  console.log('CHI-05 TEST: FAIL');
  failures.forEach(f => console.log(' - ' + f));
  process.exit(1);
} else {
  console.log('ALL TESTS PASS');
  console.log('CHI-05 TEST: PASS');
}
```
